jobs.occupation: Customer Service | Czech + English + Eastern-European Language
jobs.description:
Are you a born problem solver with a passion for customer satisfaction? Do you want to work in an international environment where no day is the same? Then we have the perfect challenge for you! At Volvo, they are looking for an enthusiastic customer service representative to join their Central-East team and contribute to their mission of getting vehicles back on the road quickly and efficiently. Your duties: 

 
• Provide first line support for international breakdowns: Wherever our customers are in Europe, you will be there to help them and address their concerns. 
 

 
• Maintain regular contact with dealers and customers: So that everyone is always informed about the progress of repairs. 
 

 
• Working together in a dedicated team: You will be part of a team that is committed 24/7 to providing our customers with the best possible support. 
 Keywords: customer support advisor, customer service, call agent, customer service representative
Bachelor thinking level. Fluent in English + Czech + one of following: Polish, Lithuanian, German (minimum B2 level). 

Flexible in working hours: Working in a full-time system is not a problem for you; rather, you enjoy the variety. Driving license B: You must be able to come to the company independently.

jobs.occupation: Customer Support Advisor: English + German + 1 other European Language
jobs.description:
For our client we're looking for a Customer Service Officer.
In this role, you become the voice of support for drivers facing unexpected vehicle issues across Europe. You'll be part of a fast-paced and multilingual contact center where your communication skills, empathy, and sense of urgency play a crucial role in keeping transport moving.

- Handle incoming assistance requests from international customers experiencing roadside vehicle breakdowns.
- Take ownership of each case by coordinating with local service providers and technicians until the issue is resolved.
- Maintain constant communication with both the customer and service partner, providing regular updates and reassurance.
- Think on your feet and apply a proactive approach to problem-solving, often finding creative solutions under time pressure.
- Be an integral part of a tight-knit, multilingual team that thrives on collaboration and mutual support.
- Operate within a 24/7 environment, where teamwork and flexibility are essential to ensuring seamless customer experiences.

- You speak and write fluently in English, German and at least one other European language.
- You are service-driven and naturally inclined to go the extra mile to support customers in stressful situations.
- Strong interpersonal skills help you adapt your communication style to various cultural and professional contexts.
- You enjoy working in a diverse team setting and are always ready to help others succeed.
- Flexibility to work in a rotating shift schedule, including nights and weekends.
- A hands-on mentality with a structured and solution-oriented mindset.
- Eagerness to continuously develop your skills and embrace new challenges.

jobs.occupation: Packer | Part-Time | Zottegem
jobs.description:
Are you accurate, flexible, and do you enjoy working in a clean production environment? For a modern food company in Zottegem, we are looking for packers.

Below is the list of tasks for this position:

• Correctly packaging fine food products according to the established standards. 
• Carrying out quality checks to ensure that every product meets our high standards. 
• Setting up and adjusting machines to guarantee a smooth production process. 
• Working together with colleagues to ensure deadlines are met and customers remain satisfied. 
• As a packer, you make sure our products are perfectly packaged before they are sent to our customers.

• You can speak Dutch or English.
• You can work either from 6h-14h, 14h-22h or 22h-6h. 
• You are at least 3 days a week available to work.
• You can choose which day and shift you wanna work.
• You have experience in a production environment.

jobs.occupation: Handyman / general facilities technician - English is allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a hands-on technician with solid electrical knowledge and a passion for maintenance, repairs, and problem-solving? Do you enjoy having variety in your work and being the go-to person for all technical issues? And are you already living in Belgium?

For a growing transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for a multi-skilled maintenance technician or handyman to help maintain the buildings, warehouse facilities, technical installations and outdoor areas. A very varied job that combines electrical maintenance, facility maintenance, repairs, troubleshooting and general handyman tasks. And the best part: Dutch isn't required, so you can also apply if you speak English very well!

Your role

As technician, you're responsible for a wide range of maintenance and repair activities across the different sites of the company. You and the rest of the technical team use your technical skills to ensure the operations run safely and efficiently.

Your key duties:

• Perform electrical maintenance and repairs
• Carry out minor repairs to plumbing, storage racks, equipment...
• Keep up the company grounds and outdoor facilities
• Help perform maintenance and repairs to the company vehicles
• Supervise external contractors and service providers

Your profile:

• Good knowledge of electrical systems and installations
• Basic knowledge of plumbing, mechanics, building maintenance, or general technical repairs
• Experience as a maintenance technician, handyman, facilities technician, general maintenance worker...
• Own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
• Very good knowledge of English
 

!! IMPORTANT ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS: please read carefully before applying !!

• You must already be living in Belgium
• You must already have a valid legal right to work in Belgium (EU citizenship or valid work permit)
Candidates who do not meet these requirements will not be considered for the position. We do not provide visa sponsorship, work permits, relocation support or immigration assistance.

jobs.occupation: Profile Rolling Machine Operator
jobs.description:
For a client in the metal industry, we are looking for an operator.

You will be responsible for operating the profiling line, ensuring the smooth handling of both the input and output of the machines. You will work in a two-shift system or a fixed night shift.

Your responsibilities:

• You will create registrations in MII/SAP. You retrieve production orders and transmit the required quantities and lengths to the machine. You perform the prescribed measurements, compare them with the specified tolerances, and adjust the process where necessary.

• You are responsible for packaging the finished product according to the given instructions.

• You handle the transport of finished goods using an overhead crane or forklift, including the required scanning and administrative registrations.

• You have completed a technical education and are able to operate a forklift confidently.

• A valid forklift certificate is considered a strong advantage.

• You have solid technical knowledge and/or a technical background.

• Experience with an overhead crane is a strong asset.

• You prioritize safety and quality at all times.

• You are able to work independently with a high level of reliability.

• You communicate fluently in English.

jobs.occupation: Secretary
jobs.description:
European Association in het center of Brussels

Jobomschrijving

Become the backbone of a collaborative team and help drive seamless operations.

Secretariat in general, including
•    administrative support to General Secretary and other staff members
•    liaise with the office landlord, suppliers and contractors to keep the office welcoming and in good shape
•    support the events organisation, i.e. the practicalities (hotel, venue, catering, …) for the yearly “National Association Meetings, “International Harmonisation Council” and a “Summit rehearsal”

Suppliers
•    Scouting if needed
•    Organizing, ordering & reception of all office supplies, drinks, etc
•    Contact with suppliers: e-mail correspondence, telephone requests
•    Price quotations, ordering with approval of General Secretary
•    Filing of contracts
•    Ordering & follow-up of maintenance/repair of material, machines
•    In contact with the cleaning service and plants’ service

Building
•    Access badges 
•    Contact with representative of the building workers for the organization and timing of works (avoiding noise & disturbance for & visitors on our busy meeting days)
•    Responsible for evacuating  & visitors in every case of alarm and during building escape exercises.  Sending report to the building representative afterwards.
•    Organise maintenance of kitchen machines

Mail
•    Opening and distribution of mail
•    E-Mailing of invitations to Summits
 

•    Checking incoming mail, answering, forwarding
•    Clearing inbox of all possible junk, clear spam box

Insurances (except for insurances linked to staff)
•    Follow-up of insurances

•    Fluent in English (written and oral). (French, Dutch or other languages are appreciated)
•    Experience in a similar function
•    Knowledgeable in IT (Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint)

jobs.occupation: COMMUNICATION AND PROJECT ASSISTANT
jobs.description:
We connect the brightest minds in Europe to make industry greener, smarter and truly sustainable.

Jobomschrijving

Primary responsibilities project management support (50%):
	
• Creating timelines and contributing to effective planning of funded project activities.	
• Monitoring budgets of EU-funded projects and tracking team members’ time dedication consistently, systematically, and coherently.	
• Supporting team members in completing tasks, drafting, and submitting reports.	
• Oversee and implement the communication and dissemination tasks of projects.	
• Support organising conferences, events, meetings, and other activities linked to projects.	
• Providing communication support to Processes4Planet projects.

Communications activities and providing value to members (50%)
	
• Create a yearly Communication Plan and track its implementation,	
• Manage and enhance the Association’s external communication channels (website, social media, newsletters, etc.), 	
• Operate members-only collaboration tools (e.g. SharePoint),	
• Manage internal communication with company members by operating the existing tools or suggesting new ideas.	
• Generate and write content for social media, news releases, newsletters, bulletins, etc.	
• Prepare presentations and small publications and manage relations with providers.	
• Support to facilitate networking activities 	
• Organise participation in external conferences, and support with organization of internal events (conferences, workshops, webinars, etc.).

Qualifications and experience:
	
• Degree in project management, communications, public relations, business administration or related studies.	
• Minimum 3 years of experience in positions dealing with the tasks described for this position, with excellent performance.	
• Experience with EU funds is an asset.

Your key skills:
	
• An energetic person with a hands-on approach, task-oriented with attention to detail	
• Team player with a cooperative spirit	
• Ability to work in a small core team and diverse virtual teams with people across organizational boundaries and several countries/regions.	
• Outstanding organisation and prioritization skills with a capacity to retro plan and fulfil strict deadlines.	
• High-quality results and output oriented.	
• Capacity to work with complexity and to juggle a variety of tasks flexibly and proactively.	
• Creative problem-solving skills, able to anticipate needs and deliver your work autonomously
Technical skills and languages:
	
• Strong skills in Word, PowerPoint, Excel and collaborative online tools (e.g. SharePoint).	
• Experience in project management.	
• Excellent spoken and written English. Other languages are an asset.

jobs.occupation: Equipment Maintenance Engineer
jobs.description:
Are you ready for a challenging career in the FAB Engineering team? Would you like to work with the most high-tech devices? Then read on quickly!

As an Equipment Maintenance Engineer, you'll start your journey in the esteemed FAB Engineering team:

• You'll get hands-on experience with the high-tech process equipment in our cleanroom. No need to be an expert from day one – we'll give you the time to thoroughly understand these cutting-edge tools. The team takes pride in maintaining and fine-tuning some of the most advanced equipment globally. You'll even get a chance to work with first versions and prototypes, which is pretty exciting!
• You will work closely with equipment manufacturers and other process engineers, so you'll be collaborating with a diverse group of experts.
• You’ll be part of the FAB Engineering team that consists of over 100 talented individuals with whom you will form the beating heart of our research institute. Specializing in nano-electronics, your work will contribute to technological solutions in various fields like healthcare and energy.

• You hold a Master's degree in Industrial Science with a focus on Electromechanics or Mechanics, or you have acquired equivalent technical experience. If you're just starting out, that's perfectly fine! We welcome motivated beginners who are eager to launch their careers.
• You are genuinely passionate about technology and equipment, and you are not afraid to work hands-on. Your technical knowledge of pneumatics, pumps, motors, electronics, and (electro)mechanics is a valuable asset.
• We highly appreciate your collaborative spirit, while also trusting your ability to proactively plan and organize your work on your own.
• You have a very good knowledge of English.
You will work in a shift regime: early - late (6u-14u & 14u-22u) and 1 weekend every 3 weeks

jobs.occupation: Production Workers & Forklift Drivers
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about metal, steel, engineering, welding, overhead cranes, or forklifts?

We are currently looking for several profiles to work in a two-shift system or a fixed night shift in Zwevezele.

We are recruiting for the following positions:

• Press brake operators

• Forklift drivers

• Loaders and unloaders

• Overhead crane operators

• Saw machine operators

• General metalworking machine operators

Your profile

• You bring a healthy dose of enthusiasm and motivation.

• You have experience working with machines and a strong interest in technology, or experience operating a forklift.

• You have solid technical insight.

• You have a very good knowledge of Dutch and/or English.

• You are available to work Monday to Friday in a two-shift system or a fixed night shift.

Working hours:

• Morning shift: starts at 5:00 or 6:00 AM, depending on the department.

• Afternoon shift: starts at 1:00 or 2:00 PM.

• Night shift: starts on Monday evening at 9:00 or 10:00 PM. On Fridays, the schedule is adjusted so you start and finish earlier, allowing you to begin the weekend sooner.
